create_label_smoothing_loss: create a LabelSmoothingCrossEntropyLoss instance with a smoothing parameter to decrease output score gaps
build_loss_from_config: build a LabelSmoothingCrossEntropyLoss from a config dictionary containing smoothing_param, ignore_index, and reduction
compute_valid_targets: compute valid one-hot target vectors from class indices by masking out ignore index values
smooth_targets: smooth valid one-hot target vectors by normalizing and adding the smoothing parameter divided by class count
run_forward_loss: run the forward pass to compute label-smoothed cross entropy loss between model output and target labels
